exec git init -b main
at 2026-07-21T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix version-
exec card config set --scope store issue.id.strategy sequential

! exec card apply future-version.json
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/version-error.txt
exec card --json list
! stdout .

exec card --json apply --dry-run current-version.json
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/preview.json
exec card --json list
! stdout .

-- future-version.json --
{"version":2,"issues":[{"title":"Future document entry","type":"task"}]}
-- current-version.json --
{"version":1,"issues":[{"alias":"audit","title":"Audit abandoned uploads","type":"task"}]}
-- golden/version-error.txt --
error: invalid input: apply document version must equal 1
-- golden/preview.json --
{"entries":[{"alias":"audit","action":"create"}],"counts":{"create":1},"dry_run":true}
